jobDescription: Every document the company's customers upload passes through the search indexing pipeline before it can be found, and the pipeline's index rebuilds are the operation that engineers fear most. The Software Engineer on the pipeline team writes the indexing jobs and the schema changes, proves each change on the replay corpus before it merges, brings index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer, answers the customer-facing teams' questions about indexing delays, and leaves a written boundary for every change. The rebuild go-ahead is the pipeline lead's. Reports to the pipeline lead; works with the search ranking team, the storage team and the customer-facing support engineers.
requirements: Writes indexing jobs and schema changes under the pipeline team's engineering standard.
Proves each change on the replay corpus with a documented replay result before merge.
Brings index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist, with the rebuild go-ahead staying with the pipeline lead.
Answers customer-facing teams' questions about indexing delays and records own responsibility boundaries.
Leaves a written boundary and hand-over note for every change.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team of a document collaboration company from 2022, writing the indexing jobs and the schema changes for the document and comment indexes under the team's engineering standard, with each change on a merge request in my name.
Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository.
Brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer; the rebuild go-ahead was the pipeline lead's each time, recorded on the rebuild checklist.

Answered the customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, marking in each thread which answers were mine and which were referred to the pipeline lead.
Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.

Work sample: two merge requests with their replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with the pipeline lead's go-ahead, and one month of the pipeline support channel, with the repository references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former pipeline lead: confirmed the candidate wrote the indexing changes and ran the rebuild checklists in the period, with the go-ahead staying with the lead, and confirmed the dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can do the pairing exercise on the proposed afternoon and confirmed the office days suit; no relocation or travel matters to arrange.

propositions.text: The candidate has written the indexing jobs and schema changes for the document and comment indexes on a document collaboration company's search indexing pipeline team since 2022, each change on a merge request in her name, and proved every change on the replay corpus before merge with the replay result attached.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the merge requests document the changes and the replay results.

propositions.text: The candidate brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer, with the rebuild go-ahead staying with the pipeline lead, and answered the support engineers' indexing delay questions in the pipeline support channel with the referral split marked.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the rebuild checklist and the reference call document the rebuilds, the go-ahead boundary and the support work.

propositions.text: The candidate left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the merge requests document the boundary notes.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the changes, the replay results, the rebuilds, the support work and the boundary notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the go-ahead boundary as documented: rebuild checklists by the candidate, rebuild go-ahead by the pipeline lead; the packet makes no judgement.
